Story: As a rights protector, I upload a signed agreement and get a structured permission record I can verify against quoted source text
Acceptance: Upload produces a consents row; every extracted field displays the verbatim source sentence and page number

Story: As a rights protector, I trigger a sweep for a performer and receive a list of suspected unauthorised uses
Acceptance: One sweep yields a deduplicated candidate list plus a visible log of Parallel calls; re-running does not duplicate findings

Story: As a rights protector, I see for each hit whether it is allowed, not allowed, or unclear — and which specific check failed
Acceptance: Every row shows a verdict, the failing check, and a verbatim evidence quote. No uncited verdicts exist

Story: As a rights protector, I generate a case file with preserved evidence and a draft notice, and send it myself
Acceptance: Case file names the specific breached clause; evidence survives the source page being removed; no send action exists anywhere in the product

Story: As a delivery gatekeeper, I upload a deliverable and learn whether a permission grant covers it
Acceptance: Two uploads produce one cleared and one blocked; an asset with no paperwork remains unverified

Story: As a delivery gatekeeper, I see a production-level blockers list before delivery
Acceptance: Blockers listed per production before delivery, each naming the missing or non-covering grant

Story: As either user, I can inspect the full decision trail for any verdict, including what data it used and how old that data was
Acceptance: Any verdict expands to its inputs, tool calls, and the cache age of each input
